title: Someone called my uncle with this “review removal” service , how does it actually work?

comments.body: Most services I know only get paid, when they are able to remove the review. Has worked for us in the past, so I would not call it a scam in general, like the guy in the other comment
comments.author: kathars1s-

comments.body: 100% pure scam. The only one that can remove Google reviews is Google.
comments.author: jroberts67

comments.body: They are either scam or shady people. It is possible they are the ones who added the bad reviews and are asking for an extortion fee to take down their own bad reviews.
comments.author: ToddlerPeePee

comments.body: Yeah you can't really remove reviews. If a review goes against Google policy you can report it. Google doesn't tell you this but DO NOT REPLY to any dodgy reviews until you report it and get feedback. After the feedback if Google hasn't removed it you should reply as best you can.
comments.author: teh-stick

comments.body: We almost hired one of these companies. Their strategy wasn’t to delete the reviews but bury them with a bunch of fake 5-star reviews.
comments.author: CompletelyMoronic

comments.body: Scam. Can’t remove bad reviews just because you don’t like them. Fix your business.
comments.author: tubadude123

comments.body: Nope. But doesn't Google remove spams anyway?
comments.author: Lazy_Surprise_6712

comments.body: You cannot remove bad reviews.  You can only push them off of page one.  Reputation management is like doing 9 SEO campaigns at once, and usually costs 9x as much.
comments.author: GrumpySEOguy
